# React (JavaScript)

Welcome to your fresh **[Robo.js](https://robojs.dev)** project!

Build, deploy, and maintain your **Discord Activities** with ease. With **Robo.js** as your guide, you'll experience a seamless, **[file-based setup](/docs/discord-activities/file-structure)**, an **[integrated database](/docs/framework/core/flashcore)**, and a **[rich ecosystem](/docs/plugins)**.

  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
  <Card href="https://robojs.dev/discord" title="Discord" description="Robo - Imagine Magic" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-js
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

<Callout>
A free Cloudflare tunnel is included for easy testing.
</Callout>

## App Development

You can find your client-side code in the `/src/app` folder. This is where you can build your web app using React.

Things are powered by Vite under the hood, so you get the latest ES modules, hot module reloading, and more!

## Backend Development

Your server-side code is located in the `/src/api` folder. This is where you can build your API, webhooks, and other server-side features.

<Files>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="app" note="Client-side code" disabled />

This backend is powered by [**@robojs/server**](/docs/server).
